name: Card dispute
summary: Disputed card transaction, from first call to evidence and follow-up.
guidance: Confirm the card's last four digits and the disputed transaction date and amount before discussing the outcome. Never ask for the full card number or the CVV.

actions.label: Request dispute evidence
actions.guidance: Receipts, merchant correspondence, or a delivery screenshot.

defaults.message: To progress your dispute, please upload any receipts or messages from the merchant. Sign in here: {portal_link}

defaults.note: Check merchant response before the chargeback window closes.
